title: Compiler code layout
statement: For a program $P$ and a Boolean choice $d$, the code layout has frame size given by the frame-size computation for $P$, procedure-entry positions computed from that size and the first body selected using $d$, and a dispatcher position computed from $P$ and $d$.
caveat: The referenced computations frameSize, entries, firstBody, and dispPos are not defined in the supplied statement, so their precise mathematical meaning cannot be stated.
